verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Cortex Code as an AI-driven coding agent integrated into the product for data engineering workflows. Its site markets agentic AI assistants (CoWork for asking, CoCo for building), and Cortex Analyst answers natural-language questions without the user writing SQL. Together these show a built-in assistant users can hand tasks to. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on what tasks the agent can execute autonomously and how delegation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Cortex Code — AI-driven coding agent integrated into Snowflake for data engineering workflows.
Bring agentic AI to all your data. Ask anything with Snowflake CoWork. Build anything with Snowflake CoCo.
With Cortex Analyst, business users can ask questions in natural language and receive direct answers without writing SQL.
